entities.summary: Uzeir Abduramanovich Abduramanov was a sapper in the Red Army during World War Two. After securing the safe transfer of troops across the Sozh river under heavy enemy fire and through icy water he was awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union for his bravery but was exiled soon after for being a Crimean-Tatar.
